optimized_sql:
SELECT w_state,
       i_item_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(d_date AS date) < CAST('2001-05-02' AS date)
                THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
       SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(d_date AS date) >= CAST('2001-05-02' AS date)
                THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after
FROM (
    SELECT w.w_state,
           sf.i_item_id,
           sf.d_date,
           sf.cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash, 0) AS net_sales
    FROM (
        SELECT cs.cs_order_number,
               cs.cs_item_sk,
               cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
               cs.cs_sales_price,
               i.i_item_id,
               d.d_date
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        JOIN item i
          ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
         AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
        JOIN date_dim d
          ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
         AND d.d_date BETWEEN CAST('2001-04-02' AS date) AND CAST('2001-06-01' AS date)
    ) AS sf
    JOIN warehouse w
      ON w.w_warehouse_sk = sf.cs_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
      ON sf.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
     AND sf.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
) AS net_rows
GROUP BY w_state, i_item_id
ORDER BY w_state, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
